issues.description: The problem statement (problem_statement.md line 22) requires a data label status_flag to be defined as a single byte. In the solution repository (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm line 4) status_flag is declared as a 4-byte double word using 'dd 1'. The template (template_repository/helloWorld.asm lines 2-4) does not declare status_flag at all. This mismatch between the specification and the solution's declared size for status_flag can confuse students about the intended data size and lead to incorrect student implementations or unexpected behavior when the flag is used.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution's declaration to match the problem statement by defining status_flag as a single byte (for example: 'status_flag db 1'). Optionally, add the same 'status_flag db 1' declaration to the template repository's data section so students see the intended definition. Ensure the problem statement and both repositories consistently use 'db' (byte) for status_flag.
